# vaked.dev — The Sovereign Constellation Ecosystem
> Machine-Readable LLM Architecture Manifesto & Constellation Directory
> Author: Peter Lodri (@0xp3t3rl) · License: AGPL-3.0 / MIT

## Overview
vaked.dev is the sovereign computing ecosystem, low-bit neural network architecture (BitNet b1.58), AST-aware quantum context tree synthesis (smart-tree), deep security scanning & supply-chain defense (magiscanner), distributed associative wave memory (MEM8), and mathematical monograph constellation developed by Peter Lodri.

## Sovereign Node & Tool Directory

- [Constellation Apex](https://vaked.dev/): Master node index, 60fps WebGL constellation canvas, and 432Hz harmonic audio engine.
- [Ocean Compute Hub](https://ocean.vaked.dev/): High-compute 1-bit inference gateway, distributed associative wave memory, autonomous agent swarm factory, and mining coordinator.
- [Fleet Worklog](https://worklog.vaked.dev/): Immutable append-only engineering board logging daily fleet milestones with JSON and RSS feeds.
- [Pocoo Monograph Fleet](https://pocoo.vaked.dev/): 85 long-form sovereign treatises, including "The Mechanics of Sovereignty: Three Days on the Metal, the Wave, and the Loop".
- [Smart Tree AST Context Engine](https://github.com/8b-is/smart-tree): Lightning-fast directory AST visualizer, quantum token compression, MEM8 commit archaeology, and MCP server.
- [MagiSCanner Security Sentinel](https://github.com/8bit-wraith/magiscanner): Deep file security scanning, hash memory, certificate trust neutralization, and supply chain attack guardian.
- [Music Constellation](https://music.vaked.dev/): 2048-particle Fibonacci sphere visualizer and 432Hz diatonic polyphonic synth.
- [Sovereign Store](https://store.vaked.dev/): Web3 token-gated lossless master stems, physical vinyl, and archival fine art prints.
- [Vision Gallery & Art](https://art.vaked.dev/): Generative visual art gallery and Paintings For Secrets ERC-721 on-chain smart contracts.
- [Axiom Quant Lab](https://axiomquant.org/): Interactive stochastic calculus suite featuring Schramm-Loewner Evolution (SLE_κ), Dyadic Wavelets, and Markowitz QP.
- [MLX Quant Love From](https://mlxquantlovefrom.com/): Apple Silicon Metal BitNet b1.58 2-bit packing inference engine achieving 40.8 GB/s memory bandwidth.
- [Portail Gateway](https://portail.vaked.dev/): Cryptographic Ed25519 identity and reverse-proxy access plane.
- [Public Proposals](https://proposal.vaked.dev/): Open-source mathematical RFCs, architecture blueprints, and grant proposals.

## Core Architectural Primitives

1. **MagiSCanner (`8bit-wraith/magiscanner`)**:
   - Deep file security scanning, certificate trust neutralization, hash integrity memory, and supply chain poisoning detection for autonomous agent swarms (`brew install 8b-is/vaked/magiscanner`).
2. **Smart-Tree (`8b-is/smart-tree`)**:
   - High-throughput Rust directory AST symbol extraction, git consciousness archaeology, and quantum context compression (`st --mode quantum`, `st --mcp`).
3. **Transformers-Ultra (`8b-is/transformers`)**:
   - Zero-overhead RoPE dimension guarding across 11 model architectures and AST reflection removal achieving >2.2x speedup on token generation loops.
4. **MEM8 Associative Wave Memory**:
   - Continuous holographic vector resonance mapping Gamma (8Hz), Beta (4Hz), Alpha (2Hz), and Theta (1Hz) cognitive bands with Swift 6 vDSP (<420ns latency).
5. **BitNet b1.58 Ternary Packing**:
   - 2-bit MSL quantization packing 4 ternary weights per byte with zero runtime float unpacking penalty.
6. **AgentField Composite Intelligence**:
   - Autonomous multi-reasoner execution graph with deterministic verification and state persistence.
